hypothesis: Consecutive-loss streak + tight-spread conditioned skip: skip the open leg of an oracle signal when EITHER (a) the last 2 consecutive closed positions both had negative estimated PnL (streak signal), OR (b) current spread > 1.1x rolling 60-tick median (spread signal). Reduce-only orders always execute. The streak captures serial correlation in adverse oracle regimes; the spread filter removes adverse entry moments where oracle reliability is lower.

hypothesis: per_iteration_experiment / brief-summary / loop 1 — built on base_algo aggressor-flow-gate by replacing the base's absolute imbalance gate (|net_flow| >= 2.0 over a 10s window) with a volume-normalized ratio gate (r = net_flow / max(abs_vol_window, min_abs_baseline=2.0); fires when |r| >= 0.35). Window length, anti-cascade flat-flag semantics, and reduce-only-always-submit semantics preserved. Intent: improve gate selectivity in busy windows (where 2 absolute contracts is noise) while keeping behavior in quiet windows. Loop 1 of brief-summary arm has no prior loops to summarize, so context_chars_in=0; the hypothesis derives from base_algo alone.
notes: PASS vs simple gate -- 11-date apples-to-apples train aggregate (Sun-Fri 2026-03-08..2026-03-20, with 20260319 OOM-killed during DBN decode and dropped from BOTH sides by the runner): afg-b-l1 $453.50/101,241 trades vs simple $43.25/111,489 trades; delta_pnl_pct=+948.55 (well above +5.0 PASS gate). Max DD -4.41%. is_weighted_bps 0.053 vs simple 0.673 (delta_is_bps=+24.42, better arrival-mid capture). However, vs base_algo aggressor-flow-gate on the same 11 dates ($970.00/87,760 trades): delta_pnl=-53.25%, trade_count +15.4% (+13,481 trades). Per-date pnl is WORSE than the base on 10 of 11 dates (only 20260308 is marginally +$7; largest drags 20260320 -$118.25 and 20260316 -$108.75). The ratio gate is RELAXED relative to the absolute gate in busy windows (35% imbalance is easier to clear there than the absolute 2-contract test), and the extra admitted orders are systematically money-losing (~$47 pnl drag per 1k extra trades). Hypothesis CONTRADICTED -- the absolute threshold is, in practice, the binding selectivity floor; the ratio reformulation alone is not viable. PASS verdict applies only to the simple baseline gate; vs base_algo refinement comparison (informational here, since this is loop 1 of the arm) is materially worse. hypothesis: per_iteration_experiment / brief-summary / loop 2 -- built on afg-b-l1 by replacing the pure-ratio gate with a CONJUNCTION: skip iff (|net_flow| >= 2.0) AND (|net_flow|/max(2.0, abs_vol_window) >= 0.35). Brief-summary context across prior loop (l1=-53.25% vs base) indicated absolute threshold is the binding selectivity floor in busy windows; conjunction was intended as a strict intersection that could not regress on either operand. Result: contradicted -- asymmetric gate means ANDing the ratio onto base RELAXES busy-window selectivity rather than tightening.
